Legato turns your voice into text in any Windows app, on your own PC. This release adds the Android app, a way to replay meetings word by word, and keeps every dictation you can't finish so you can try it again.

## Download

| You have                                          | Get                                   |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| A Windows PC                                      | `Legato_0.11.0_x64-setup.exe`         |
| A Windows PC on Arm (Surface Pro X, Copilot+ PCs) | `Legato_0.11.0_arm64-setup.exe`       |
| Apps you run as administrator                     | `Legato_0.11.0_x64_en-US.msi` instead |
| An Android phone or tablet (Android 10 or later)  | `Legato-android-0.4.0.apk`            |

Both update themselves from here: Windows when Legato starts, Android when the app opens (you confirm the install). Neither is code-signed yet, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC" (choose More info, then Run anyway) and Android asks once to allow installs from your browser. You can [verify a download](https://github.com/Abhash-Chakraborty/legato/blob/main/docs/verify.md) first.

## Meetings

- Play a meeting back word by word: the word being said lights up, and clicking a word jumps there.
- Fix a misheard word, or several, and the fix stays tied to that moment in the recording. A few seconds after your last fix, the summary, action items and title catch up.

## Nothing lost

- A dictation you cancel stays in Home, ready to copy, transform or write up.
- On the phone, a dictation or memo that couldn't be written up (no PC, no model, a dropped link) keeps its audio and is written up once your PC is back, or from Try again.

## Legato for Android

- Pair it with your PC by QR code. It syncs your Dictionary, snippets, history, notes and Scratchpad over Wi-Fi, or Bluetooth when there's no shared network. No account and no server in between.
- Dictate in any app from a bubble, with your PC's speech model or the phone's own. A slow PC doesn't hold you up: after a couple of seconds the phone writes up your words too, and the first text back is typed.
- Voice memos are written up while you talk, and your PC adds a summary, a title and tags.
- Transforms run on the phone with the AI key your PC shares. What you copy on one reaches the other.

## Fixes

- AI cleanup asks again on a fresh connection when an answer hangs, instead of giving up.
- Copied files come back on the clipboard after a dictation or a transform.
- The bubble and the Notes side panel land where they should on a second screen.
- Closed to the tray, Legato's windows give back most of their memory.

## Known issues

- The installers and the APK aren't code-signed yet (see above).
- Word-by-word timing comes from Parakeet and similar models. With Whisper, the highlight moves through each line evenly instead.
